name: Pure DC Westpoort Amsterdam
overview: Pure DC signs Europe's largest standalone hyperscale lease in 2025 for a 78 MW campus in Westpoort, Amsterdam, investing over €1Bn. The facility targets hyperscale cloud providers seeking European infrastructure at scale.
summaryShort: Europe's largest standalone hyperscale lease 2025. 78 MW Amsterdam.
updates: 2025 – Largest standalone hyperscale lease signed in Europe.

name: Brookfield AI Campus – Strängnäs
overview: Brookfield Asset Management develops one of Europe's largest AI data center campuses in Strängnäs, Sweden, scaling from 300 MW to 750 MW IT load on 350,000 m². Powered by 100% renewable energy from Nordic hydropower grid. Part of Brookfield's €20Bn European digital infrastructure strategy.
summaryShort: 750 MW AI campus Strängnäs. Largest in Europe. SEK 95Mrd.

name: DC01UK Hertfordshire AI Hub
overview: DC01UK develops a £3.75Bn hyperscale AI and cloud campus in Hertfordshire, UK, receiving planning approval in 2025. One of Europe's largest planned AI hubs targeting hyperscale cloud and enterprise AI workloads with Tier III certification.
summaryShort: £3.75Mrd hyperscale AI hub Hertfordshire. Planning approved 2025.

name: Meta Talavera de la Reina Campus
overview: Meta Platforms constructs a 191-hectare data center campus in Talavera de la Reina, Castilla-La Mancha. The €750M investment creates 250 direct and 300 construction jobs supporting Meta's European AI operations.
summaryShort: Meta €750M campus 191 ha Spain. 250 direct jobs.

name: CyrusOne FRA7 Frankfurt Westside
overview: CyrusOne develops FRA7, a 126 MW campus on 63,000 m² at Frankfurt Westside in partnership with BEOS AG and Swiss Life Asset Managers. E.ON partnership adds 61 MW on-site gas power by 2029. 40 MW of waste heat supplied to district heating network.
summaryShort: 126 MW Frankfurt. E.ON power partnership. 40 MW waste heat.

name: Virtus Berlin Campus 1-4
overview: Virtus Data Centers builds a 57.6 MW Berlin campus comprising four 14.4 MW buildings across 19,000 m². Partnership with DATA2HEAT supplies waste heat to 5,000 households. Tier III, PUE under 1.2, 100% renewable energy.
summaryShort: 57.6 MW Berlin campus. Tier III PUE<1.2. Heat for 5,000 homes.

name: Digital Realty AMS11 Amsterdam
overview: Digital Realty launches its 12th data center in the Netherlands. AMS11 adds 27 MW of IT capacity across 12,000 m², bringing total Dutch capacity to approximately 159 MW. Serves growing cloud demand in the Amsterdam market.
summaryShort: Digital Realty 12th DC Netherlands. 27 MW, 12,000 m².

name: HyperCo DAMAC Kouvola Finland
overview: HyperCo Oy, part of DAMAC Digital (Dubai), develops a €1Bn data center in Kouvola, Finland as part of TikTok's Project Clover, a €12Bn initiative protecting data of 175 million European users. Powered by Finnish renewable energy grid.
summaryShort: €1Mrd Kouvola Finland. TikTok Project Clover €12Mrd EU data.
updates: 2024 Q1 – Announced as part of TikTok Project Clover.

name: Microsoft Spain AI Data Centers
overview: Microsoft invests $3.2Bn across three data center facilities in Spain, adding 20,000 GPUs for Azure AI services. Reinforces Spain as a strategic Southern European cloud hub. Announced by Microsoft President Brad Smith during Madrid visit.
summaryShort: $3.2Mrd 3 DC Spain. 20,000 GPU Azure AI. Brad Smith announced.
updates: 2024 Q1 – $3.2Bn Spain investment announced by Brad Smith.

name: Equinix PA10 Paris La Défense
overview: Equinix develops PA10, a new International Business Exchange data center in Paris La Défense, adding 28 MW of IT capacity. The facility serves financial services and enterprise cloud customers in the Paris market.
summaryShort: Equinix PA10 Paris La Défense. 28 MW financial services focus.

name: Microsoft France Datacenter Paris
overview: Microsoft announces €4Bn investment in French data center infrastructure as part of Brookfield's broader €20Bn France AI commitment. The investment focuses on Azure AI cloud services for French and European enterprise customers.
summaryShort: Microsoft €4Mrd France AI datacenter. Azure expansion EU.

name: Google Dublin Data Center Expansion
overview: Google expands its Clonee data center campus near Dublin with additional capacity to support growing European cloud demand. Investment over €1Bn reinforcing Ireland as Google's primary European data hub.
summaryShort: Google €1Mrd Dublin expansion. European cloud hub reinforcement.

name: Amazon AWS Frankfurt Region Expansion
overview: Amazon Web Services invests €7.8Bn in expanding Frankfurt cloud region infrastructure through 2029 to meet growing European enterprise and AI workload demand. Multiple new availability zones and data center buildings.
summaryShort: AWS €7.8Mrd Frankfurt expansion 2024-2029. European cloud AI.

name: Vantage Data Centers LON12 London
overview: Vantage Data Centers develops LON12 adding significant hyperscale capacity in the London market. The facility serves major cloud providers and enterprises requiring London-based colocation.
summaryShort: Vantage LON12 hyperscale London. Major cloud colocation expansion.

name: G42 UAE AI Cloud Campus Abu Dhabi
overview: G42 develops a major AI cloud campus in Abu Dhabi in partnership with Microsoft following their $1.5Bn strategic investment. The facility is central to UAE's AI ambitions and provides GPU compute for regional AI services.
summaryShort: G42 Microsoft AI campus Abu Dhabi. $1.5Mrd Microsoft partnership.

name: Blackstone Aragon Data Center Campus
overview: Blackstone develops a €7.5Bn, 300 MW data center campus in Aragon, Spain, receiving Declaration of General Interest (DIGA) from the regional government. A 150 MW power concession was approved by Red Eléctrica de España in 2024. The campus will operate on 100% renewable energy.
summaryShort: 300 MW €7.5Mrd Aragon. DIGA + Red Eléctrica concession obtained.
updates: 2024 Q4 – 150 MW Red Eléctrica concession approved.

name: Brookfield Data4 France AI Programme
overview: Brookfield commits €20Bn to develop data centers and AI infrastructure across France over five years. €15Bn led by portfolio company Data4 for data center construction. Announced at Paris AI Action Summit in February 2025.
summaryShort: €20Mrd France AI programme. Data4 leads €15Mrd DC construction.
updates: 2025 Q1 – €20Mrd announced at Paris AI Summit.

name: Blackstone Northumberland AI Facility
overview: Blackstone plans Europe's largest AI data center in Northumberland, UK, with a £10Bn investment creating 4,000+ jobs. The campus is part of the UK National AI Strategy and will serve hyperscale AI workloads.
summaryShort: £10Mrd AI DC Northumberland. Europe's largest. 4,000 jobs.

name: Nscale Loughton Essex AI Campus
overview: Nscale invests £2.5Bn in an AI data center campus in Loughton, Essex. Signed an $865M, 10-year, 40 MW colocation agreement with WhiteFiber NC-1. Expanding European and North American AI infrastructure capacity.
summaryShort: £2.5Mrd AI campus Essex. WhiteFiber 40 MW $865M deal signed.

name: Nscale Portugal Porto AI Campus
overview: Nscale announces $812.6M AI data center campus in Portugal expanding Southern European AI infrastructure capacity. The facility targets GPU compute for AI training and inference workloads.
summaryShort: $812M Nscale AI campus Porto Portugal. Southern EU AI expansion.

name: Kao Data Stockport Manchester
overview: Kao Data constructs a £350M data center in Stockport, Greater Manchester, serving cloud, AI and HPC workloads. The facility is part of UK strategy to distribute data center capacity outside London. EPC contract awarded to ISG plc.
summaryShort: £350M DC Stockport Manchester. Cloud AI HPC. ISG plc EPC.
updates: 2025 Q1 – EPC awarded to ISG plc.

name: Colt DCS FRA6 Frankfurt Hyperscale
overview: Colt Data Centre Services builds FRA6, two hyperscale data centers with 54 MW combined IT capacity 10 km east of Berlin. 9.5-acre site, Tier 3, 80 MVA power supply. Serves cloud and HPC workloads.
summaryShort: Colt FRA6 54 MW Frankfurt. Tier III 80 MVA. Cloud HPC.

name: AtlasEdge Lisbon Campus
overview: AtlasEdge uses $292M sustainability-linked funding to develop two data centers in Lisbon. Benefits from Portugal's green electrical grid and strong renewable energy infrastructure making it an efficient location for carbon-neutral operations.
summaryShort: AtlasEdge $292M green finance Lisbon. 2 DCs renewable grid.

name: Verne Global Helsinki Expansion
overview: Verne acquires land to expand its Helsinki campus for AI and HPC workloads up to 70 MW capacity. Benefits from low-latency connectivity and Finland's 100% renewable energy grid including hydropower and wind.
summaryShort: Verne 70 MW Helsinki AI HPC campus. 100% renewable Finland.

name: Digital Realty FRA20 Frankfurt
overview: Digital Realty announces FRA20 in Frankfurt delivering 16 MW IT capacity across 8,100 m² in two phases. Part of Digital Realty's continued Frankfurt campus expansion strategy.
summaryShort: Digital Realty FRA20. 16 MW 8,100 m² Frankfurt. 2 phases 2027.

name: Iron Mountain AMS1 Amsterdam
overview: Iron Mountain expands into Amsterdam colocation market with AMS1, a new facility targeting European enterprise data management and compliance requirements. The company leverages its records management customer base.
summaryShort: Iron Mountain AMS1 Amsterdam. Enterprise compliance colocation.

name: Saudi Aramco AI Data Center Dhahran
overview: Saudi Aramco develops a major AI data center in Dhahran as part of Saudi Vision 2030 digital transformation. The facility supports oil & gas AI analytics and broader Saudi cloud sovereignty goals.
summaryShort: Saudi Aramco AI DC Dhahran. Vision 2030 digital transformation.

name: Leaseweb Paris Data Center FR1
overview: Leaseweb develops FR1, a new data center in Paris expanding its European hosting and colocation capacity. The facility targets web hosting providers, e-commerce platforms and content delivery networks.
summaryShort: Leaseweb FR1 Paris hosting colocation. CDN e-commerce focus.

name: Telehouse West London TW3
overview: Telehouse develops TW3 at its West London campus, adding 30 MW capacity to serve financial services and media companies. Adjacent to existing TW1 and TW2 buildings with shared connectivity and power infrastructure.
summaryShort: Telehouse TW3 West London. 30 MW finance media colocation.

name: Pantheon AI Atlas Croatia Campus
overview: Pantheon AI announces a €50Bn AI data center campus in Croatia called Atlas, potentially the largest single datacenter investment ever announced globally. The hyperscale campus targets AI training workloads at unprecedented scale.
summaryShort: €50Mrd Pantheon Atlas Croatia. Largest DC investment ever announced.
updates: 2025 Q1 – Atlas campus announced in Zagreb.

name: Apto Lacchiarella Milan Campus
overview: Apto develops the Lacchiarella Data Center Campus near Milan, one of Italy's largest planned facilities at €3Bn covering 228,000 m² with up to 5 separate data center buildings for AI and cloud applications.
summaryShort: €3Mrd Lacchiarella 228,000 m² 5 DC Milan. Italy's largest planned.

name: SAMCA Green IT Aragón Complex
overview: Renovables SAMCA plans the Green IT Aragón data center campus in Luceni, Zaragoza on 408 ha across three phases totaling 300 MW. Powered by seven local wind farms. 2,300 construction jobs and 320 permanent jobs created.
summaryShort: 300 MW 408 ha Green IT Aragón. 7 wind farms. 2,300 jobs.
